channel.title: UI Hub · AI Design Techniques Blog
channel.description: Original analysis: we synthesise multiple public sources in our own words and add our take and checklists. Every post ends with full references.

item.title: Generative UI gets a design system: CopilotKit catalogs, surfaces and A2UI 1.0
item.description: On 29 October CopilotKit shipped a 70-component catalog, page “surfaces” and a markdown mode for generative UI, all on Google’s A2UI 1.0 protocol; two days earlier Google added A2UI Express, a compact format that cuts tokens up to 3×. The shift for designers: when an agent builds screens, the component catalog becomes the design system’s contract. What changed, what it means for UI teams, and a checklist for a catalog agents can’t break. / 10 月 29 日，CopilotKit 为生成式界面发布了 70 个组件的标准目录、可放在页面任意位置的「surface 区域」和 Markdown 模式，全部基于 Google 的 A2UI 1.0 协议；两天前 Google 推出了 A2UI Express，一种最多省 3 倍 token 的紧凑格式。对设计师来说，变化在于：当智能体来搭界面，组件目录就成了设计系统的「合同」。本文讲改了什么、对 UI 团队意味着什么，以及一份让智能体「改不坏」的组件目录清单。

item.title: Canva Brush: AI design moves from generating to editing
item.description: On 29 October Canva Research launched Brush, a vision-language model trained to edit existing designs: it reads the layout, writes code to change elements, checks the page and keeps everything editable. Canva claims up to 69% faster and 46% cheaper edits than its previous agent. What it does, what the numbers do and don’t prove, how it compares with Krea’s brand-kit-first Ad Studio, and a checklist for edit prompts that change only what you meant. / 10 月 29 日，Canva Research 发布了 Brush：一个专门用来「修改现有设计」的视觉语言模型。它读懂版面结构，写代码改元素，再检查页面，结果全部保持可编辑。Canva 称它比自家上一代设计智能体快最多 69%、每次修改成本低 46%。本文讲它能做什么、这些数字能说明什么不能说明什么、它和 Krea 先抽品牌套件的 Ad Studio 有何不同，以及一份「只改你想改的」修改提示清单。

item.title: GitHub Replica: AI prototypes that start from your design system, not a blank page
item.description: On 28 October GitHub open-sourced Replica, an MIT-licensed prototyping tool from GitHub Design and Microsoft CoreAI Design that runs in the Copilot app. Its real idea is not the canvas but the guidance: reviewed context files split by owner, drafts kept out of active use, missing evidence marked manual instead of passed. What it does, where it is heavy, and a checklist you can apply even without Replica. / 10 月 28 日，GitHub 开源了 Replica：一款由 GitHub Design 与 Microsoft CoreAI Design 打造、运行在 Copilot 应用里的原型工具，MIT 许可。它真正值得看的不是画布，而是「规范」的管法：按负责方拆分、经过评审的上下文文件，草稿不进入生效状态，缺证据就记为人工检查而不是默认通过。本文讲它能做什么、哪里偏重，以及一份即使不用 Replica 也能照做的清单。

item.title: Point, don’t describe: visual prompts for UI edits in Cursor, v0 and Lovable
item.description: On 27 October Cursor added Annotate to Design Mode: click, box, draw, edit text or CSS on your running app and the agent gets the element’s identity plus a cropped screenshot. v0 and Lovable already let you point at a preview. What each one actually sends to the model, where pointing beats a paragraph, where it quietly breaks your design system, and a checklist for notes that land first time. / 10 月 27 日，Cursor 给 Design Mode 加上了 Annotate：在运行中的应用上点选、框选、涂画、改文字或改 CSS，智能体就能拿到元素身份信息和一张裁好的截图。v0 和 Lovable 也早已支持在预览上直接指。本文拆解三者到底把什么交给模型、什么时候「指」比一段话更好用、什么时候它会悄悄绕开你的设计系统，以及一份让批注一次命中的清单。

item.title: Your design tools now take orders from agents: Framer MCP, Figma Weave and Runway App Studio
item.description: In five days Framer opened its canvas and CMS to outside agents over MCP, Figma made every Weave image and video model callable from the Figma MCP, and Runway turned plain-language descriptions into shareable creative apps. Three different ways to put a creative tool behind an agent, what each one gates, our take, and a checklist for setting it up safely. / 五天之内，Framer 通过 MCP 把画布和 CMS 开放给外部智能体，Figma 让 Weave 的所有图像和视频模型都能从 Figma MCP 调用，Runway 则能把一段自然语言描述变成可分享的创作应用。这是把创作工具交给智能体的三种不同方式：各自在哪里设了关卡，我们的看法，以及一份安全上手清单。

item.title: Designing approvals for agents that act for people: budgets, previews and when to interrupt
item.description: In one week Walmart announced Agent Profiles with spending limits, Anthropic opened Claude Duet, which asks before it sends, pays, signs or deletes, and 1Password shipped approvals for agent sign-ins. Together they sketch a shared pattern for agent permission UI: what each one shipped, our take, and a checklist for your own product. / 一周之内，Walmart 公布了带消费上限的 Agent Profiles，Anthropic 开放了在发送、付款、签署或删除前都会先问你的 Claude Duet，1Password 也上线了智能体登录审批。三者拼出了一套智能体授权界面的共同模式：它们各自发布了什么，我们的看法，以及一份可用于你自己产品的清单。

item.title: AI vectors for UI: what Ideogram Vector 1.0 changes, and the checks before an SVG ships
item.description: On 22 October Ideogram shipped Vector 1.0, a model that writes editable SVG from a prompt or traces an image, joining Recraft V4.1 and QuiverAI Arrow 2. Editable is not the same as ready for an interface: what the three tools actually return, and a checklist for icons and illustrations. / 10 月 22 日，Ideogram 发布 Vector 1.0：根据提示词直接生成可编辑的 SVG，也能把图片描成矢量，与 Recraft V4.1、QuiverAI Arrow 2 站到了一起。可编辑不等于能直接放进界面：三款工具实际给出什么，附一份图标和插画的检查清单。

item.title: Lint the agent: keeping AI-written UI on your design system
item.description: On 22 October the open-source onsystem went public, joining shadcn’s agent-first linter and Figma’s new Guidelines and system check. The shared idea: stop asking agents to follow your design system and start checking every edit. What the benchmark shows, and a setup checklist. / 10 月 22 日，开源工具 onsystem 公开发布，与 shadcn 面向智能体的 Lint 工具、Figma 新推出的 Guidelines 和系统检查站到了一起。共同思路是：别再只“请”智能体遵守设计系统，而是检查每一次编辑。基准测试说明了什么，附一份配置清单。

item.title: Layers, brand kits and JSON: three ways AI visuals stop looking generic
item.description: On 20 October Coco Labs launched Vyb, a design model that builds in layers; Gemini started remembering an uploaded brand style; and Bria shipped Fibo 2, which turns every edit into editable JSON. Three different answers to the same problem, and a checklist for using them. / 10 月 20 日，Coco Labs 发布了按图层构建设计的模型 Vyb，Gemini 开始记住你上传的品牌风格，Bria 推出了把每次编辑都变成可改 JSON 的 Fibo 2。同一个问题的三种解法，附一份实用清单。

item.title: Lovart 2.0 and Arti: design agents learn to remember, run and review
item.description: Lovart 2.0 adds an editable taste memory, scheduled design delegation and a background consistency check. Read alongside two other launches from 19 Oct, it shows where design agents are heading, and what you should write down before you hand one the work. / Lovart 2.0 加入了可编辑的审美记忆、可定时的设计委托和后台一致性检查。和 10 月 19 日另外两项发布放在一起看，能看出设计智能体的走向，也能看出把活交出去之前你该先写清楚什么。

item.title: shadcn Trace and AI Elements: one shape for every step an agent takes
item.description: On 14 Oct 2026 shadcn/ui shipped Trace, Code Block and 21 copy-in AI Elements patterns that replace AI SDK Elements. The design lesson: reasoning, tool calls, sources and subagents are all one line with an icon, a title and a status, so agent UIs stop looking like debug logs. / 2026 年 10 月 14 日，shadcn/ui 发布 Trace、Code Block 和 21 个可直接复制的 AI Elements 模式，取代 AI SDK Elements。设计上的启发：推理、工具调用、来源和子智能体都是同一种「一行」——图标、标题加状态，智能体界面从此不再像调试日志。

item.title: Figma code layers and Specs: the canvas becomes the shared context again
item.description: At Config India (15 Oct 2026) Figma moved code layers into open beta, launched Specs as a Markdown home on the canvas, and let libraries carry guidelines and code sources. The lesson for UI builders: agents are short of constraint files, not generators. / 在 Config India（2026-10-15）上，Figma 让代码图层进入公开测试，推出把 Markdown 放上画布的 Specs，并让组件库携带规范与代码源。给界面构建者的结论：智能体缺的不是生成器，而是约束文件。

item.title: Claude Design everywhere: out of beta, into every chat
item.description: Anthropic took Docs, Slides and Design out of beta on every plan, launched Dashboards and Motion in beta, and will close the standalone Design site on 14 Dec 2026. For UI builders the practical move is to migrate the design system now. / Anthropic 让 Docs、Slides、Design 在所有套餐正式可用，推出 Dashboards 与 Motion 测试版，并宣布独立 Design 站点将于 2026-12-14 关闭。界面构建者现在就该迁移设计系统。

item.title: Tutorial: have an agent build a landing page using UI Hub as context
item.description: Six steps from an empty folder to a verified page: load AGENTS.md, search the encyclopedia, pick components, load skills, build, verify in a browser. / 从空文件夹到验证通过的页面六步走：加载 AGENTS.md、搜索百科、挑组件、加载技能、构建、浏览器验证。

item.title: Weekly roundup, 14 Oct 2026: guideline files go mainstream
item.description: Figma agent GA with team guidelines, Lovable drops its pick-a-look step, Magic Patterns launches MagicOS, Chrome iterates on HTML-in-Canvas. What it means for your workflow. / Figma 智能体正式可用并支持团队规范，Lovable 取消「先选风格」步骤，Magic Patterns 推出 MagicOS，Chrome 迭代 HTML-in-Canvas。对你的工作流意味着什么。

item.title: Design skills for Claude and Cursor: SKILL.md, rules and AGENTS.md
item.description: Three file formats, one idea: durable instructions an agent loads when relevant. How to write a design skill that changes output, with a template. / 三种文件格式，一个思路：智能体在相关时加载的持久指令。怎样写一个真正改变产出的设计技能，附模板。

item.title: Design tokens for agents: the file that makes AI output on-brand
item.description: A machine-readable token file (the W3C DTCG format) plus a short usage note beats any adjective in a prompt. Structure, naming, and how to hand it to an agent. / 一份机器可读的 Token 文件（W3C DTCG 格式）加一段简短用法说明，胜过提示里任何形容词。结构、命名和交给智能体的方法。

item.title: Dashboard patterns that hold up: from KPI strip to drill-down table
item.description: AI tools love to generate twelve charts. Good dashboards answer three questions in order: is it OK, what changed, why. A layout and a component list for each. / AI 工具爱生成十二张图表。好的仪表盘按顺序回答三个问题：正常吗、变了什么、为什么。每一层对应的布局和组件。

item.title: Landing page teardown: what Linear and Vercel get right
item.description: Two widely copied developer-tool homepages, read as a list of decisions: one message, product as hero image, dark restraint, and proof placed right after the promise. / 两个被大量模仿的开发者工具首页，拆成一串决策：一句主张、产品即首图、克制的深色、承诺之后紧跟证据。

item.title: OKLCH colour systems: palettes that survive dark mode
item.description: OKLCH keeps perceived lightness consistent across hues, so you can generate scales and dark themes by math instead of eyeballing. Tailwind v4 uses it by default. / OKLCH 让不同色相的感知亮度保持一致，色阶和暗色主题可以靠计算而不是靠肉眼。Tailwind v4 默认就用它。

item.title: Typography for AI-generated UI: the fastest way to look less generic
item.description: Generators default to one sans at three sizes. A type scale, a second typeface, tighter tracking on display sizes and real line lengths fix most of it. / 生成器默认一种无衬线、三个字号。一套字号阶梯、第二种字体、大字号收紧字距和合理行长，能解决大部分问题。

item.title: shadcn blocks and registries: page sections as source code
item.description: Blocks (dashboards, sidebars, login pages) install with one CLI command, and any team can publish its own registry. Why this is the best substrate for AI agents. / Blocks（仪表盘、侧栏、登录页）一条 CLI 命令就能装，任何团队都能发布自己的 registry。为什么这是 AI 智能体最好的底座。

item.title: Cult UI deep dive: tactile components with personality
item.description: shadcn-compatible components that feel physical: dynamic islands, textured buttons, expandable cards. How to borrow personality without breaking consistency. / 兼容 shadcn、带物理手感的组件：灵动岛、质感按钮、可展开卡片。如何借来个性而不破坏一致性。

item.title: Magic UI deep dive: animated components that install like shadcn
item.description: An open-source (MIT) set of motion components distributed through the shadcn registry. Best picks for SaaS pages and how to keep them accessible. / 一套开源（MIT）的动效组件，通过 shadcn registry 分发。SaaS 页面最值得用的几个，以及如何保持无障碍。

item.title: Aceternity UI deep dive: spectacle, used sparingly
item.description: Copy-paste React + Tailwind + Motion effects that made the "fancy" landing look popular. Which pieces carry a page and which turn it into a demo reel. / 可复制粘贴的 React + Tailwind + Motion 特效，带火了「fancy」落地页风格。哪些能撑起页面，哪些会把页面变成特效合集。

item.title: Prompt-to-UI tools compared: v0, Lovable, Bolt, Figma Make, Magic Patterns
item.description: Not a leaderboard: a decision guide by what you are shipping, where the output lives, and how much design control you need. / 不是排行榜，而是决策指南：按你要交付什么、产出放在哪里、需要多少设计控制来选。

item.title: MagicOS: Magic Patterns bets on an infinite canvas of AI threads
item.description: Launched 13 Oct 2026: one coordinator chat spawns parallel design threads on a shared canvas. What it fixes (lost context) and when a single design is still better. / 2026-10-13 发布：一个协调者对话在共享画布上派生多个并行设计线程。它解决了什么（上下文丢失），什么时候单个设计仍更合适。

item.title: Figma Make and the Figma agent: AI moves onto the canvas
item.description: Figma Make turns prompts into working prototypes; the Figma agent, generally available since 6 Oct 2026, reads team guideline files. Why the guideline file matters most. / Figma Make 把提示变成可交互原型；Figma 智能体自 2026-10-06 正式可用，能读取团队规范文件。为什么规范文件才是关键。

item.title: Lovable and Bolt: when prompt-to-UI becomes prompt-to-app
item.description: Both tools build whole apps, so design quality now competes with data, auth and deploys for attention. How to keep the look from being an afterthought. / 两者都能生成完整应用，于是设计质量要和数据、登录、部署抢注意力。如何不让视觉沦为事后补丁。

item.title: v0 in practice: from a prompt to shadcn code you can keep
item.description: v0 is strongest when you treat it as a shadcn/Tailwind code generator, not a design oracle. Brief it like an engineer, then pull the code into your repo. / v0 最强的用法是把它当 shadcn/Tailwind 代码生成器，而不是设计神谕。像给工程师写需求一样写提示，然后把代码拉进自己的仓库。

item.title: Accessibility in AI-generated UI: the checks models skip
item.description: Generated UIs look fine and fail keyboards and screen readers. Start from accessible primitives, then audit against WCAG 2.2. / 生成的界面看着没问题，键盘和读屏却用不了。先用无障碍底层组件，再按 WCAG 2.2 走查。

item.title: Dark mode done right: tokens, elevation and contrast
item.description: Dark mode is a second palette, not an inverted one. Use semantic tokens, lighter surfaces for elevation, and desaturated accents. / 暗色模式是第二套配色，不是反色。用语义 token，用更亮的表面表达层级，强调色要降饱和。

item.title: Motion that feels right: purpose, duration, easing, restraint
item.description: Most UI motion should be under 300ms, ease-out, and skipped for frequent actions. Spectacle belongs on marketing pages, not in tools. / 大多数界面动效应在 300ms 内、用 ease-out，高频操作干脆不做。炫技属于营销页，不属于工具。

item.title: Component composition: why headless + copy-paste won
item.description: Radix behaviour, your styles, code you own. Compound components keep APIs small and make AI edits safer. / Radix 管行为，样式归你，代码在你仓库里。复合组件让 API 更小，AI 改起来也更安全。

item.title: Teaching agents taste: how design skills de-slop AI interfaces
item.description: Skills like frontend-design, taste-skill and impeccable package opinions as files agents load on demand. Here is how to combine them. / frontend-design、taste-skill、impeccable 等 skill 把设计观点打包成文件，Agent 按需加载。这里讲怎么组合。

item.title: Design-to-code with AI: map to your components, not to pixels
item.description: Pixel-perfect export creates throwaway code. Give the agent your component registry and tokens via MCP so output reuses what you already ship. / 像素级导出只会产出一次性代码。通过 MCP 把组件注册表和 token 交给 Agent，让产出复用现有组件。

item.title: Prompting for UI: write specs, not wishes
item.description: "Modern and clean" means nothing to a model. Name layout, tokens, states, content and what to avoid. / "现代、简洁"对模型毫无信息量。要写清布局、token、状态、真实内容和禁区。

item.title: AI-assisted UI design: a workflow that keeps taste in the loop
item.description: Generators are fast but average. Split the job: humans set direction and constraints, AI explores variants, humans curate and polish. / 生成器快但平庸。把活拆开：人定方向和约束，AI 铺变体，人来挑选和打磨。
